title: Some phenomenological aspects of a quantum-corrected Reissner-Nordström black hole: quasi-periodic oscillations, scalar perturbations and thermal fluctuations
summary: In this work, we investigate several phenomenological aspects of a covariant quantum-corrected Reissner-Nordström black hole characterized by the mass $M$, electric charge $Q$, and the quantum correction parameter $ζ$. We first study the motion of neutral test particles and derive the fundamental orbital and epicyclic frequencies, which are then employed to analyze different quasi-periodic oscillation (QPO) models.
